text: Done, uncommitted in the working tree on top of bc7a418. Cause: the cursor's change digest covered identifiers only, so a rename that kept an entry's position passed unnoticed and the renamed entry sorted after its own old key and was returned twice. Fix in modules/application/.../Directory.scala: the digest covers every matching row's displayed name and identifier in order, so any visible rename gives the documented 409 restart. Also fixed: search and order folded case with the server's default locale; they now use NFC and Locale.ROOT (under tr-TR a search for 'index' missed 'INDEX study'). Criteria: 1 rename A to AA restarts and the restarted traversal has each row once; 2 one total order for empty and equal names, foreign principal, directory, query and page size refused; 3 revocation and expiry between pages restart and totals follow (expiry is exercised through the real policy function with a fixed clock, not by wall-clock waiting); 4 the pure function is the only paging implementation and PostgreSQL directories agree. Evidence: DirectoryPageSuite (9 tests) and two new DirectorySuite cases; on the old code 3 pure tests and the PostgreSQL rename case fail. Full gate scripts/check-postgres.sh passed: 683 unit, 377 integration, crash and restore. docs/http-api.md states the contract precisely.
